product: Connect ChatGPT to Genie One with the Databricks Genie plugin
tagline: The Databricks Genie plugin connects ChatGPT to the Genie One MCP, so users can ask questions about their data from ChatGPT.
what_it_does: The Databricks Genie plugin connects ChatGPT to the Genie One MCP, so users can ask questions about their data from ChatGPT. A ChatGPT admin sets up the plugin for the ChatGPT workspace, and each user connects by signing in with their Databricks account. The Genie One MCP server is a Databricks provided MCP that exposes Genie as a conversational tool over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), leveraging Chat in Genie One.
why_it_matters: Genie resolves business terms, metric definitions, and table relationships through Genie Ontology, your governed semantic layer, which produces more accurate answers than an agent writing SQL directly against raw tables.
